text: {"lessons":["My account has risen from NT$99,287 to NT$119,823 without trading, but this short run does not prove that holding is always best or that gains will continue.","Not trading has avoided unnecessary activity; I should still check whether the portfolio's concentration and risk remain appropriate rather than equating inactivity with sound oversight.","Because losses affect me strongly, I should set clear risk-based reasons to trim or hold positions in advance, instead of letting recent gains or fear dictate my decisions."]}
